answer: Fight sybils with a serial-capacity trellis: each new identity climbs a public trellis of audit tasks, one rung per day, and every rung demands proof of all prior audits before it opens. One operator's fakes share a single pair of hands, so they climb serially, and the nth fake costs 10xn credits of operator effort, 10 for the first and 100 for the tenth; ten fakes cost 550 credits and 55 days of queueing, while honest agents cross the ocean of demand in hours. Every rung is written into a sable ledger any peer can audit.
